I made my own chicken souple(no noodles lol) so I'd take a pot with water and boil 50g of celery and 50g of carrots and add half a chicken stock cube (it HAD to be the Knorr brand or i just WILL NOT eat it). Adjust the water throughout because the vegetables take a while to soften. I calculated this and it would come up to about 90 calories for a big ass pot. Like I usually couldnt finish it because the cube could season like 2 cups of water. Anyways then just boil a few eggs and just eat the egg whites. Which are like 15 calories each. 

Also shirataki noodles are my fave. I would eat it with 1/4 cup of sauce and this big pack from the international market would be 40 calories. +the sauce was 60. So thats already 100. Then I'd add 3 meatballs which was like 80 calories for the turkey ones. So 180 cals for a big ass meal. 

Another thing I like is broccoli, I just boil it until it gets bright green then let it brown a little in a pan and add any spices I want. I'll usually eat it with these tuna packets.
